body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> MSI presented its all-new 'Wind NetOn' product line at CES 2009.

The new Wind NetOn lineup emphasizes on an integrated one-piece design, environmentally friendly energy-saving features and a stylish exterior that deliver satisfactory performance at reasonable prices without taking up extra space.

Unveiling for the time at the CES are several new Wind NetOn products. These are further divided among the E (Entertainment), P (Professional) and C (Classic) series depending on their target market. Available in 16-, 19- and 22-inch models, these Wind NetOn products are intended for audio-video entertainment, business professionals or home and education.

Apart from the Wind NetOn range, MSI also releases the new Wind NetTop and Wind NetBox products. While the Wind NetOn emphasizes its one-piece design, the Wind NetTop is a compact desktop computer that is just a quarter the size of an ordinary desktop PC. This means the table doesn't have to be dominated by a computer any more. As for the Wind NetBox, with a volume of just 1 litre, it's targeted at the market of special purpose computers.
